name: Ante Kovačić
bio:
Ante's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering. Growing up near a local go-kart track, he spent countless hours observing the mechanics and developing a keen eye for detail. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Zagreb, he worked for a small automotive parts manufacturer before transitioning to motorsport. He joined Cavaleiro Sports three years ago, initially as a junior technician, quickly proving his worth through meticulous work and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Ante believes that quality control is more than just checking boxes; it's about anticipating potential issues and finding innovative solutions to prevent them. He approaches his work with a blend of technical expertise and a practical mindset, always seeking the most efficient and reliable methods. His colleagues appreciate his dedication and his ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. Ante's commitment to excellence makes him a vital asset to the team, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards.

physical.description: A man of average height, Ante carries himself with a quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific type of caliper for all precision measurements.
